facts.text: It was comprised of cold blue-sand deserts in the lower latitudes and on the equator, snow-covered forests further north with inhospitable mountain ranges in the subpolar regions.

evidence.quote: It was comprised of cold blue-sand deserts in the lower latitudes and on the equator, snow-covered forests further north with inhospitable mountain ranges in the subpolar regions.

facts.text: During the High Republic Era, it was sparsely inhabited by a Yarkora colony in its southern latitudes and monasteries of Ming Po monks in the northern regions.

evidence.quote: During the High Republic Era, it was sparsely inhabited by a Yarkora colony in its southern latitudes and monasteries of Ming Po monks in the northern regions.

facts.text: During the High Republic Era in 231 BBY, Carlac was the site of a battle of Operation: Counterstrike during the Nihil conflict.

evidence.quote: During the High Republic Era in 231 BBY, Carlac was the site of a battle of Operation: Counterstrike during the Nihil conflict.

facts.text: Later during the era, the Republic prison transport Palwick transporting Osha Aniseya crash landed in Carlac's northern mountains.

evidence.quote: Later during the era, the Republic prison transport Palwick transporting Osha Aniseya crash landed in Carlac's northern mountains.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, A town inhabited by members of the Ming Po culture existed on Carlac, but was burned to the ground by the radical Mandalorian terrorist group Death Watch.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, A town inhabited by members of the Ming Po culture existed on Carlac, but was burned to the ground by the radical Mandalorian terrorist group Death Watch.

facts.text: Though the planet lacked moons, a loose asteroid ring orbited Carlac.

evidence.quote: Though the planet lacked moons, a loose asteroid ring orbited Carlac.

facts.text: Its atmosphere was breathable to humans, and the planet had a cold, frozen climate.

evidence.quote: Its atmosphere was breathable to humans, and the planet had a cold, frozen climate.

facts.text: The surface was covered in forests, mountain chains in the north, and cold blue-sand deserts in the lower latitudes and on the equator.

evidence.quote: The surface was covered in forests, mountain chains in the north, and cold blue-sand deserts in the lower latitudes and on the equator.

facts.text: Molasse rocks found in the northern mountains were made from primeval marine deposits, and ancient thrust tectonics caused fold mountain outcroppings to form, with rocky arches formed from expanding frozen water and wind erosion.

evidence.quote: Molasse rocks found in the northern mountains were made from primeval marine deposits, and ancient thrust tectonics caused fold mountain outcroppings to form, with rocky arches formed from expanding frozen water and wind erosion.

facts.text: The mountains contained winding caves.

evidence.quote: The mountains contained winding caves.

facts.text: Blue dust particles from the southern latitudes were swept into the northern regions to mix with mountain snow.

evidence.quote: Blue dust particles from the southern latitudes were swept into the northern regions to mix with mountain snow.

facts.text: The Piteous Ranges were a subpolar mountain chain devoid of even primitive lichens.

evidence.quote: The Piteous Ranges were a subpolar mountain chain devoid of even primitive lichens.

facts.text: Carlac was the site of a battle of Operation: Counterstrike during the conflict between the Galactic Republic and Nihil in 231 BBY.

evidence.quote: Carlac was the site of a battle of Operation: Counterstrike during the conflict between the Galactic Republic and Nihil in 231 BBY.

facts.text: The responses also made the Republic and Jedi more certain of the false belief that Lourna Dee was the Eye of the Nihil.

evidence.quote: The responses also made the Republic and Jedi more certain of the false belief that Lourna Dee was the Eye of the Nihil.

facts.text: By 132 BBY, Carlac had sparse habitations in its southern latitudes; a Yarkora colony had settled in the blue equatorial deserts, and Ming Po monks were in the process of raising monasteries to the north.

evidence.quote: By 132 BBY, Carlac had sparse habitations in its southern latitudes; a Yarkora colony had settled in the blue equatorial deserts, and Ming Po monks were in the process of raising monasteries to the north.

facts.text: The DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick crashed in Carlac's northern mountains after its occupants deactivated the ship's pilot droids and stole its escape pods.

evidence.quote: The DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick crashed in Carlac's northern mountains after its occupants deactivated the ship's pilot droids and stole its escape pods.

facts.text: Osha shared this information when she was soon after confronted on a rocky cliff by Jedi investigators.

evidence.quote: Osha shared this information when she was soon after confronted on a rocky cliff by Jedi investigators.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars between the Republic and the secessionist Confederacy of Independent Systems, Carlac was home to a camp belonging to the Mandalorian terrorist faction Death Watch.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars between the Republic and the secessionist Confederacy of Independent Systems, Carlac was home to a camp belonging to the Mandalorian terrorist faction Death Watch.

facts.text: A celebration was interrupted by Pieter, Chieftain of the nearby Ming Po Town, who demanded Death Watch return the women they had taken as slaves.

evidence.quote: A celebration was interrupted by Pieter, Chieftain of the nearby Ming Po Town, who demanded Death Watch return the women they had taken as slaves.

facts.text: When Death Watch arrived at the town, Vizsla killed Pieter's granddaughter in front of him and ordered his soldiers to burn the village down.

evidence.quote: When Death Watch arrived at the town, Vizsla killed Pieter's granddaughter in front of him and ordered his soldiers to burn the village down.

facts.text: Tano revealed herself to be a Jedi, attempting to defend the village, but she was ultimately captured.

evidence.quote: Tano revealed herself to be a Jedi, attempting to defend the village, but she was ultimately captured.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War following the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Force spirit of the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi told his apprentice Luke Skywalker the fate of Carlac, and many other planets, would rely on him confronting the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the Battle of Endor.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War following the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Force spirit of the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi told his apprentice Luke Skywalker the fate of Carlac, and many other planets, would rely on him confronting the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the Battle of Endor.

facts.text: Death Watch's occupation of Carlac was mentioned in "Mandalorians Through the Ages," a publication by the historian Eloc Throno.

evidence.quote: Death Watch's occupation of Carlac was mentioned in "Mandalorians Through the Ages," a publication by the historian Eloc Throno.

facts.text: Carlac first appeared in "A Friend in Need," an episode of the fourth season of the animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars that first aired on January 13, 2012.

evidence.quote: Carlac first appeared in "A Friend in Need," an episode of the fourth season of the animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars that first aired on January 13, 2012.

facts.text: In an earlier version of the episode's script, the environment would have been a desert, but the filmmakers didn't want to feature another planet like Tatooine, and series supervising director Dave Filoni instead suggested "Japanese cherry blossoms" for Carlac's look.

evidence.quote: In an earlier version of the episode's script, the environment would have been a desert, but the filmmakers didn't want to feature another planet like Tatooine, and series supervising director Dave Filoni instead suggested "Japanese cherry blossoms" for Carlac's look.

facts.text: The environment of the landing area was modeled by Carlos Sanchez and was finished on September 22, 2010.

evidence.quote: The environment of the landing area was modeled by Carlos Sanchez and was finished on September 22, 2010.

facts.text: Carlac later made it's live-action debut in the first episode of the 2024 live-action TV series Star Wars: The Acolyte.

evidence.quote: Carlac later made it's live-action debut in the first episode of the 2024 live-action TV series Star Wars: The Acolyte.

facts.text: In it's earliest iteration, it originally would have been Boz Pity and would have been a desert planet as series creator Leslye Headland felt that it was "very Star Wars".

evidence.quote: In it's earliest iteration, it originally would have been Boz Pity and would have been a desert planet as series creator Leslye Headland felt that it was "very Star Wars".

facts.text: In the original scene, Aniseya would have wandered across the desert and concept art of the area was created by Adam Brockbank, Doug Chiang and Jama Jurabaev and showed a dusty environment with enormous stone pillars and giant animal skeletons.

evidence.quote: In the original scene, Aniseya would have wandered across the desert and concept art of the area was created by Adam Brockbank, Doug Chiang and Jama Jurabaev and showed a dusty environment with enormous stone pillars and giant animal skeletons.

facts.text: However, production designer Kevin Jenkins said that, although he though that the idea was cool, that they couldn't do another desert for financial reasons.

evidence.quote: However, production designer Kevin Jenkins said that, although he though that the idea was cool, that they couldn't do another desert for financial reasons.

facts.text: The filmmakers then later instead pivoted to a cold planet and chose Carlac.

evidence.quote: The filmmakers then later instead pivoted to a cold planet and chose Carlac.

facts.text: Supervising Art Director James Lewis thought that the snowy landscape provided a nice contrast with the dusty environment of the previous scene on Ueda and also still felt like Star Wars.

evidence.quote: Supervising Art Director James Lewis thought that the snowy landscape provided a nice contrast with the dusty environment of the previous scene on Ueda and also still felt like Star Wars.

facts.text: Concept art of the new areas was done by Vincent Jenkins, Jon McCoy, Chris Lees, and Ferenc Norhof.

evidence.quote: Concept art of the new areas was done by Vincent Jenkins, Jon McCoy, Chris Lees, and Ferenc Norhof.

facts.text: Also for financial reasons, the sequence of Aniseya wandering outside the wreckage was changed to her instead walking through the destroyed set of the ship.

evidence.quote: Also for financial reasons, the sequence of Aniseya wandering outside the wreckage was changed to her instead walking through the destroyed set of the ship.
